comment: The module declares a Pitch output at index 0 that no code ever writes and that has no widget on the panel, so it cannot be clicked and gets no line. The panel prints the black keys as C# / Db and so on; the lines spell them out for the voice. Note that the twelve key gates are written before the switch is consulted (Segfault.cpp:75-77), so a switched-off note still raises its own key gate and is only stopped from reaching the GATE output. Nothing at all is written while the pitch input is unpatched, which leaves stale voltages on every jack.
